heroHeadline: Trump Claims Strait of Hormuz 'Belongs to the US', Threatens to Sink Iranian Vessels Breaching Naval Blockade
heroSubtitle: President Trump's declaration that Hormuz belongs to the United States and threat to sink Iranian vessels marks a sharp escalation in US rhetoric, raising the prospect of direct naval confrontation in the world's most critical oil chokepoint
